The number in front, such as "2×", says how many times that problem appeared, and the sentence next to it says what to do.
Se no lugar da frase aparecer só um nome: If, instead of the sentence, only a technical name appears, such as "conteudo_bloqueado", it is a type of failure this screen does not explain yet. In that case, find the execution on the list and open its technical message.

On the right, the AI company (the provider) and the model used. The line below has three numbers: the size of the work in tokens (the small pieces of text the AI read and wrote), how long the AI took, in milliseconds (1000 ms is 1 second), and how much it cost, in dollars, the currency the provider charges in. Last come the date and time.
No fim da última linha, depois da hora,: At the end of the last line, after the time, the card says who chose the model. "Set in the agent's published version." means the model comes from the agent itself, configured on the Agents screen. In two short tasks, "Identify the lead's stage" and "Block manipulation attempts", you may see "Most economical model from the same provider": when no one has chosen a model for them, the system uses the cheapest model from the same AI company, because the task is simple.
Para escolher você mesmo o modelo de uma: To choose the model for a task like this yourself, use the Providers screen (AI agent › See everything in AI › Providers). After that, the executions of that task start saying "Chosen by you in the providers panel.".

Quando a chamada à IA falha, o cartão ga: When the call to the AI fails, the card gets a red border and the "failed" badge next to the task name. It does not show tokens, time or cost. O que aconteceu e o que fazer: What happened and what to do
A explicação vem em duas partes, sempre: The explanation comes in two parts, always in this order. "What happened:" says what this failure causes in customer support: here, the customer sends a message and no one replies. "What to do:" gives the fix: here, the AI provider did not accept the key, and the way forward is to check the key on the Credentials screen (AI agent › See everything in AI › Credentials), because keys can be revoked or expire.
Em algumas falhas a linha \"O que aconte: In some failures the "What happened:" line does not appear. This happens, for example, when another AI covered the failure right away or when the AI that failed was only observing: no one was left without a reply.
Por último, escondida, fica a mensagem o: Last, hidden, is the original message from the AI provider, often in English. Click "Provider technical message" to open it. It is for whoever investigates, or for support. Here, "invalid x-api-key" means "invalid key", and "code 401" is the refusal for lack of authorization.
Ao gravar essa mensagem, o sistema tira: When saving this message, the system removes any keys and personal data the provider may have returned, and cuts very long texts.

Nem toda falha pede conserto seu. Nesta,: Not every failure needs a fix from you. In this one, the system tried to summarize a long conversation and the AI provider was down or took too long (in the technical message, "Overloaded" means the provider was overloaded). The "What to do:" line warns that this usually resolves itself. If it keeps happening, the screen's advice is to switch providers for that task.
Costuma passar sozinha: Usually goes away on its own
Esta falha foi de propósito. Em \"Uso e: This failure was on purpose. In "Usage and budget", in the same hub, the administrator can set a monthly AI spending limit and choose to stop the AI when it is reached. When the month's spending reaches the limit, the system refuses the calls before they go out to the provider, and the customer gets no reply. To bring the AI back, raise the limit, turn off the stop or wait for the new month.
Se a sua empresa usa o sistema num plano: If your company uses the system on a reseller's plan, this same failure also appears when the AI usage included in the plan runs out. In that case, the fix is not the "Usage and budget" limit: the technical message shows the way, which is to change plans, register your own AI key or wait for the new month.

It is different from a Follow-up: a Follow-up picks up a conversation that went cold, while a support flow guides the conversation that is happening now. "New support flow" creates a flow from scratch. "Import flow" brings in a flow that someone exported to a file.

The AI then stops using the script right away, and anyone in the middle of the questions is left on hold. To put it back online, open the flow and click "Publish".

Onde você sobe uma planilha (CSV ou Exce: Where you upload a spreadsheet (CSV or Excel) with companies, the people who make the decisions there and their phone numbers, to register everything at once, and check row by row what went in, what had a conflict and what failed.
Conhecendo a tela de Importações: Getting to know the Imports screen
Saber para que serve a importação de pla: Know what spreadsheet import is for, where it is and what the batch list shows.
Importações mora em Ver tudo em CRM: Imports lives in View everything in CRM
Importações é onde você sobe uma planilh: Imports is where you upload a spreadsheet with companies, the people who make the decisions there and those people's phone numbers, to register everything at once instead of typing them one by one. At Clínica Bem Viver, it is used to bring in the list of companies that hire health programs for their employees. To get there, open "View everything in CRM", in the "CRM" group of the side menu, and click the "Imports" card, in the "Preparing the sale" section. The path is CRM › View everything in CRM › Imports.
O cartão só aparece quando quem administ: The card only appears when the server administrator turns on "Companies and people (B2B sales)" in Admin › Optional features. When it is off, the screen disappears for everyone. When it is on, the card appears for people with the "Manager" or "Administrator" role, and only these two roles can import.
Duas partes: subir a planilha e a lista: Two parts: uploading the spreadsheet and the batch list
A tela tem duas partes. No alto fica o q: The screen has two parts. At the top is the panel for uploading the spreadsheet: the "File" field and the "Import" button. Below is the list of batches. A batch is a spreadsheet that someone has already imported, with the file name and a count of what happened to its rows. The newest batch appears first.
A lista mostra os 50 lotes mais recentes: The list shows the 50 most recent batches.
Cada linha da lista é um lote. \"Arquivo: Each row in the list is a batch. "File" is the name of the spreadsheet. Clicking it opens the batch. "Status" appears in English, as the system stores it: "completed" means the import has finished. While it is still running, "processing" appears. "Rows" is how many rows with data the spreadsheet had, not counting the first one, the one with the column names. Completely blank rows are skipped and are not counted. "Success" is how many went in. "Conflicts" is how many had a phone number that already belongs to another person. "Failures" is how many could not go in. "Date" is when the spreadsheet was imported.
Montar a planilha do jeito que o sistema: Build the spreadsheet the way the system understands it, import it and know where the data appears afterwards.
A planilha pode ser CSV ou Excel (.xlsx): The spreadsheet can be CSV or Excel (.xlsx). The first row must have the name of each column, because the system recognizes each one by its name: "Empresa" (or "Razão social" and "Nome fantasia"), "CNPJ", "Nome" (or "Pessoa", "Contato", "Decisor"), "Cargo", "Telefone" (or "Celular", "WhatsApp") and "E-mail". Uppercase and lowercase do not matter, but the name must be one of these. A column with any other name is not used. Each following row usually has one person and their company.
A planilha pode ter até 2.000 linhas e 2: The spreadsheet can have up to 2,000 rows and 2 MB. From Excel, only the first sheet is read. The old ".xls" format is not accepted: save as ".xlsx" or ".csv".
Clique no campo \"Arquivo\" e escolha a: Click the "File" field and choose the spreadsheet on your computer. The "Import" button stays disabled until you choose a file.
Com o arquivo escolhido, o botão \"Impor: With the file chosen, the "Import" button is no longer disabled. Click it. The import starts right away, with no preview and no confirmation question. While the system reads the spreadsheet, row by row, the button shows "Importing…". At the end, a summary such as "Batch processed: 3 ok, 1 conflicts, 2 failures." appears below the button, and the new batch goes to the top of the list, like "empresas-parceiras-outubro.csv" in the screenshot. In the screenshot, the button is still disabled only because no file was chosen.
Confira a planilha antes de clicar: esta: Check the spreadsheet before clicking: this screen has no button to undo a batch, and what it registered stays. If the file does not work, the same place below the button shows the reason, such as "Unsupported format — send .csv or .xlsx." or "I need a header and at least one row of data.", and nothing is imported.
O lote entra no alto: The batch goes to the top
Para cada linha, o sistema cadastra a em: For each row, the system registers the company, registers the person linked to it as a decision-maker, with the job title from the spreadsheet, and saves the phone number as a contact for that person. Rows with the same CNPJ stay in the same company. Without a CNPJ, rows with the same company name in the same spreadsheet do too. If the CNPJ was already registered, the person joins the company that already exists. If the phone number already belonged to a contact with no linked person, the system reuses that contact and links it to the person, instead of repeating the number. If it already belongs to another person, the row becomes a conflict. Afterwards, the companies appear in "Companies", the people in "People" and the phone numbers in "Contacts". The screenshot shows Fernanda and Rogério. He came without an email in the spreadsheet, so he appears with a dash. No deal is created in the pipeline.
Quando o CNPJ é de uma empresa nova, o s: When the CNPJ belongs to a new company, the system then looks up its public data by itself in a free CNPJ lookup service (BrasilAPI), such as the legal name, the Federal Revenue status and the address. For that, the server needs internet access. A company without a CNPJ does not go through this lookup.
Conferindo um lote: conflitos e falhas: Checking a batch: conflicts and failures
Abrir um lote, ver o que aconteceu com c: Open a batch, see what happened to each row of the spreadsheet and know what to do with failures and conflicts.

Para ver o que aconteceu com cada linha: To see what happened to each row of a spreadsheet, click the file name in the list.
Uma linha para cada linha da planilha: One row for each spreadsheet row
No alto ficam o nome do arquivo e o resu: At the top are the file name and the summary: the batch status and how many rows were correct, how many had a conflict and how many failed. The table has one row for each row of the spreadsheet. "#" is the row number in the spreadsheet: 2 is the first one after the row with the column names. "Status" says what happened, in English: "success" (it went in), "conflict" (a conflict) or "failed" (it failed). "Error" gives the reason. The "Company", "Person" and "Contact" columns show the beginning of the internal code of the company, the person and the contact that the row registered or used. A dash means the row does not have that item: row 4 came without a phone number, so it has no contact, and the rows that failed have none of the three.
Linhas com o mesmo código em \"Company\": Rows with the same code in "Company" are in the same company, like rows 2 and 3. If the spreadsheet has completely blank rows in the middle, they are skipped, and the number in "#" no longer matches the one in the spreadsheet.
Uma linha falha, em geral, por um destes: A row usually fails for one of these three reasons, and then it registers nothing: no company, no person, no contact. "Invalid CNPJ.": the number does not have 14 digits or the last two, which check the others, do not match. It is usually a typo. The new CNPJ, with letters, is not accepted yet and also falls here. "Invalid phone number.": the area code or some digits are missing; write it with the area code, like (11) 98765-4321. "Empty row — no company, person or phone number.": the row had nothing usable. Fix these rows in the spreadsheet and import a spreadsheet with only them. To see only the conflicts, check "Conflicts only", just above the table.
Do not import the whole spreadsheet again. Each import registers the people again, and the companies without a CNPJ too. And the phone numbers that already have an owner become conflicts.
Com \"Só conflitos\" marcado, a tabela m: With "Conflicts only" checked, the table shows only the rows with a conflict. A conflict means the row's phone number already belongs to another registered person. Here, the number in row 5 already belonged to Sérgio Tavares, who came in with the "decisores-feira-de-saude.xlsx" spreadsheet. That is why "Contact" shows the code of Sérgio's contact, and not a new contact. The import does not change the owner of a phone number. The company and the person from the row were registered anyway, but the person was left without that number, which stays with Sérgio. No screen moves the number to another person: the conflict stays recorded here so you can check with the company which number is the right one.

Entender o que a Memória da IA guarda, o: Understand what the AI Memory stores, where it is and where each learning comes from.

Cada vez que um administrador publica o: Each time an administrator publishes the document, a new version is created, with a number, date and time. The previous one is not deleted: it is kept in "Version history". The "active" badge marks the version the agents are reading. Clicking a version shows its text.
Como voltar a um texto antigo está na li: How to go back to an old text is explained in the lesson "Go back to a previous version".

O selo ao lado do título diz quem escrev: The badge next to the title says who wrote the learning. "manual": someone on the team wrote it on this screen. "learned automatically": the system reviewed real conversations, suggested the learning, and an administrator approved the suggestion. "noted by the agent": an AI agent noted it on its own, while working.
As sugestões automáticas não aparecem ne: Automatic suggestions do not appear on this screen: they wait on the "Proposals" tab, inside any agent's screen (in "Agents"), and only become a learning when an administrator clicks "Apply as org memory". Escrever e publicar as regras da casa: Write and publish the house rules
Mudar o texto-base que todos os agentes: Change the base text that all agents follow and put the new version into effect.
Tudo o que está neste quadro vai junto e: Everything in this box goes along with every reply from the agent. Só o administrador publica. Um gerente t: Only the administrator publishes. A manager can also open this screen and write in the box, but the "Publish version" button stays disabled, with the notice "Only admins can publish a new version."
Clique no quadro e escreva. Aqui, a clín: Click the box and write. Here, the clinic added a rule about rescheduling at the end. Below, the counter shows how many characters the text has. While you write, nothing changes for the agents. The "Publish version" button only lights up when the text is different from the active version and is not empty.

A versão nova vale para todos: The new version applies to everyone
Depois do clique, o texto vira a versão: After the click, the text becomes version 3, and the badge changes to "v3 active". A quick notice confirms the publication. From the next reply on, all agents already follow the new text. Version 2 is still kept in the history, just below.
A nova no histórico: The new one in the history
Voltar a uma versão anterior: Go back to a previous version

Abre uma janela com o título \"Versão v1: A window opens with the title "Version v1", the date it was published and the exact text of that version. To close without changing anything, click the X. To go back to that text, click "Restore as new version".
O texto da v1 é copiado para o quadro, e: The text of v1 is copied into the box, and the window closes. Restaurar a versão que já está ativa só: Restoring the version that is already active only brings back its text. Since it is the same as what already applies, the "Publish version" button stays disabled.
Ensinar aos agentes um fato pontual e ti: Teach the agents a specific fact and take out of use what no longer applies, without losing anything.
Um aprendizado é um fato ou uma correção: A learning is a specific fact or correction, such as "follow-up visits within 30 days are not charged". Unlike the document, it has no versions and does not need to be published. To teach one, click "New learning", in the "Learnings" panel.
Gerente também cria, arquiva e reativa a: Managers can also create, archive and reactivate learnings.

Quando um aprendizado deixa de valer, ou: When a learning no longer applies, or when you do not agree with something an agent noted, click "Archive", at the bottom of the item. Here, we will archive the agent's note about Pilates.
Não existe botão de apagar. Arquivar tir: There is no delete button. Archiving takes the learning out of use without losing the text.
O item sai da lista, e os agentes deixam: The item leaves the list, and the agents stop considering it from the next reply on. It was not deleted: it stays among the archived ones. To see them, click "View archived learnings". This option only appears when there is at least one archived learning.

Conhecendo a tela de Planos de tarefa: Getting to know the Task plans screen
Achar a tela, entender o que é um plano: Find the screen, understand what a task plan is and what each card shows.
Planos de tarefa não aparece direto no m: Task plans does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Task plans" card is in the "Everyday sales work" section. The full path is: CRM › View everything in CRM › Task plans.
Se o cartão não aparecer, a área foi esc: If the card does not appear, the area was hidden from navigation: with the "Simplified" "Interface profile", it disappears. Administrators choose the company's visible areas in Settings › Organization, in the "Side menu" panel, and each person's in "Team".
Muitos atendimentos pedem sempre os mesm: Many customer interactions always need the same steps. At the clinic, after the physiotherapy assessment, someone calls the next day, sends the available time slots and, a few days later, asks whether the patient wants to sign up for the package. A task plan stores this sequence just once. When the plan is applied to a pipeline deal, each step becomes a task on the "Tasks" screen, with a due date and an assignee.
Esta tela só monta os planos. Quem aplic: This screen only builds the plans. What applies a plan to a deal is an automation, with the "Apply a task plan to the deal" action. That is covered in the last lesson.
Cada plano salvo vira um cartão: o nome: Each saved plan becomes a card: the name at the top, the description just below and the numbered steps, in the order the tasks will be created. "Due in (days)" is each task's deadline, counted from the moment the plan is applied: 1 means one day later, at the same time; 0 means right away.
Codes in braces, such as {{contact.name}}, are replaced with the patient's name when the task is created. The card does not show each step's priority or person: to see them, click "Edit".
Cada cartão tem dois botões. \"Editar\": Each card has two buttons. "Edit" opens the plan in the form, so you can change whatever you need. "Delete" removes the plan. Both are covered in the lesson "Edit and delete a plan".
Qualquer pessoa da equipe abre esta tela: Anyone on the team can open this screen and see the plans, but only managers or administrators can save or delete. For everyone else, the buttons appear, but saving is refused with the notice "Insufficient permission".
Montar um plano novo, passo a passo, e s: Build a new plan, step by step, and save it for automations to use.
Clique em \"Novo plano\", no alto, à dir: Click "New plan", at the top right. The form opens just below the screen title, above the list of plans.
Em \"Nome do plano\", escreva um nome qu: Under "Plan name", write a name the team will recognize: it is what appears in the automations' list of plans. "Description (optional)" says when to use the plan. The counter below shows how many of the 300 characters you have used.
Cada passo vira uma tarefa. Em \"Título\: Each step becomes a task. Under "Title", write what needs to be done. You can use two codes, which the system replaces when it creates the task: {{contact.name}} becomes the contact's name (the patient) and {{lead.title}} becomes the deal's name. That way the task already says who to talk to from the start.
\"Vence em (dias)\" diz quantos dias dep: "Due in (days)" says how many days after the plan is applied the task is due; here, 25. "Priority" goes from Low to Urgent and starts at Medium; we chose High. Under "Assign to", "Deal owner" gives the task to whoever is responsible for the deal when the plan is applied. You can also choose a fixed person from the team.
Se um passo usa \"Dono do negócio\" e o: If a step uses "Deal owner" and the deal has no one responsible, the whole plan is not applied and no task is created. People with read-only access do not appear in the list of people.
Clique em \"Adicionar passo\" para pôr o: Click "Add step" to add another task to the sequence. Here, step 2 is checking whether the patient confirmed the follow-up, three days after step 1, and it always goes to Ana Ribeiro, chosen by name. A plan can have up to 30 steps. "Remove step" takes a step off the list.
Confira e clique em \"Salvar plano\". Se: Check everything and click "Save plan". If the plan name or a step's title is missing, or if a due date is not a whole number from 0 to 365 days, nothing is saved and a red notice appears at the top of the screen, above the form. "Cancel" closes the form without saving anything.
Num plano comprido, a tela fica rolada p: In a long plan, the screen stays scrolled down and the notice does not show right away: if nothing seems to happen after "Save plan", scroll up to read the notice.
O plano entrou na lista: The plan is on the list
O formulário fecha e o plano novo aparec: The form closes and the new plan appears at the end of the list, with both steps and their due dates. From now on, it can be chosen in automations.
Mudar um plano que já existe e apagar um: Change an existing plan and delete one that is no longer needed.
Para mudar um plano, clique em \"Editar\: To change a plan, click "Edit" on its card. Let's edit "Physiotherapy post-assessment".
O formulário já vem preenchido: The form comes already filled in
O mesmo formulário de \"Novo plano\" abr: The same "New plan" form opens at the top of the screen, with everything the plan already has, including each step's priority and person. Here we change the due date of step 2, the one for sending the available time slots, from 2 to 3 days.
\"Remover passo\" tira o passo da sequên: "Remove step" takes the step out of the sequence. Let's remove step 3. If it is in the middle, the steps below move up and are renumbered.
O passo 3 saiu do formulário. Clique em: Step 3 is gone from the form. Click "Save plan". The change applies to the next times the plan is applied; the tasks it already created stay as they are.
Um negócio que já recebeu este plano não: A deal that already received this plan does not receive it again, not even after the change: the system applies each plan only once to each deal.
O formulário fecha e o cartão mostra o p: The form closes and the card shows the plan with two steps. Step 2 is now due in 3 days.
Para apagar um plano, clique em \"Exclui: To delete a plan, click "Delete" on its card. Note: there is no confirmation question; the plan disappears immediately and does not come back.
Uma automação que usava o plano apagado: An automation that used the deleted plan stops creating tasks. Each time it runs, the "Activity" tab in Webhooks warns that the chosen plan no longer exists.
O plano saiu da lista: The plan is off the list
O cartão \"Boas-vindas ao paciente novo\: The "New patient welcome" card disappeared and only the other plan is left. The tasks the deleted plan had already created remain on the "Tasks" screen.
Aplicar o plano com uma automação: Apply the plan with an automation
Fazer o plano virar tarefas sozinho, qua: Make the plan turn into tasks on its own when something happens to the deal.
usar o plano no negócio: use the plan on the deal
O plano vira tarefas por meio de uma aut: The plan turns into tasks through an automation: a rule of the kind "when this happens, do that". Automations are in the menu's "Channels" group, under "Webhooks", on the "Automations" tab. Click "New automation".
Só gerente ou administrador vê o menu \": Only managers or administrators see the "Webhooks" menu.
Dê um nome à automação. Em \"QUANDO\", e: Give the automation a name. Under "WHEN", choose what triggers the rule. Here, "When a deal is won": when the patient signs up for the treatment and the deal is marked as won in the pipeline, the rule runs.
Em \"ENTÃO\", abra \"Adicionar ação\" e: Under "THEN", open "Add action" and choose "Apply a task plan to the deal". The "Task plan" field shows the list of plans saved on the Task plans screen. Choose "New patient welcome".
O que acontece quando a regra roda: What happens when the rule runs
A cada negócio ganho, o plano cria as su: For each won deal, the plan creates its tasks in the order of the steps, with due dates counted from that moment. The same plan is not applied twice to the same deal, and the deal's timeline records that the plan was applied. The automation starts paused: after "Create automation", turn on its switch in the list of automations.
Se algum passo usa \"Dono do negócio\" e: If any step uses "Deal owner" and the deal has no one responsible, the plan is not applied and no task is created. The result of each run of the rule appears on the "Activity" tab in Webhooks.
A lista do que a empresa vende, com preç: The list of what the company sells, with price and stock: it is where the AI agent looks up the price when a customer asks how much something costs.
Conhecendo a tela de Produtos: Getting to know the Products screen
Achar o catálogo, entender para que ele: Find the catalog, understand what it is for and what each row shows.
Produtos não aparece direto no menu late: Products does not appear directly in the side menu. In the menu's "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Products" card is in the "Preparing the sale" section. The full path is: CRM › View everything in CRM › Products.
Se o cartão não aparecer, a área foi esc: If the card does not appear, the area was hidden from navigation: with the "Simplified" "Interface profile", it disappears. Administrators choose the company's visible areas in Settings › Organization, in the "Side menu" panel, and each person's in "Team". People with the "Support staff" or "Read-only" role can see the catalog but cannot change it.
Produtos é a lista do que a clínica vend: Products is the list of what the clinic sells, each with its price. It includes services, such as a consultation or a session package, and shelf items, such as a supplement. When a customer asks "how much is it?" on WhatsApp, the AI agent looks up the product in this list and replies with the registered price instead of guessing.
O atendente de IA só consulta esta lista: The AI agent only checks this list when the "Search for a product in the store" tool is enabled on the agent: in "Agents", open the agent and look for the "What the agent can do" panel. If the product is not in the catalog, it finds nothing and is instructed not to make up a price and to say it will check with the team.
Cada linha é um produto. Em cima vem o n: Each row is a product. The name is on top. Below it are the code, the brand (if any) and the stock. "12 in stock" is how many units the clinic has. "no stock control" means nobody counts units of that item, as with a session package: it always counts as available. The sale price is on the right. If the product has a photo, the first one appears small at the start of the row.
Com \"0 em estoque\", o produto continua: With "0 in stock", the product stays in the list, but the AI agent does not offer it as available: when the customer asks for that exact product, the search says it is out of stock and advises not to promise it.
Os comandos do alto da tela: The controls at the top of the screen
No alto ficam os comandos. A caixa de bu: The controls are at the top. The search box finds a product. "New product" opens the form to add an item. "Import spreadsheet" brings in several products at once from a file. "Download spreadsheet template" downloads a sample spreadsheet with the right columns.
Os botões de cadastrar e alterar e o lin: The add and edit buttons and the template spreadsheet link only appear for people with the "Manager" or "Administrator" role. "Support staff" and "Read-only" users see the list and search, without the buttons.
Digite um pedaço do nome, do código, da: Type part of the name, code, brand or category. Here, "nutri" found the nutrition consultation by its name and the two supplements by the NutriVida brand. Below the list, "1–3 of 3" shows how many products the search found. The screen shows 50 products at a time; when there are more, the "Previous page" and "Next page" buttons appear.
A busca começa a partir de 2 letras ou n: The search starts at 2 letters or numbers. With just one, the screen shows "No products found for this search". To see everything again, delete what you typed.
Pôr um produto novo no catálogo, com pre: Put a new product in the catalog, with price and stock, so the AI agent can answer with its price.
A clínica começou a vender faixas elásti: The clinic started selling elastic bands for physical therapy exercises. To put a new product in the catalog, click "New product". The form opens just below, above the list.
Só gerente ou administrador vê o botão \: Only managers or administrators see the "New product" button.
\"Código\" é a identificação do produto: "Code" is the product's identifier at the clinic, like a shelf label. It cannot be repeated: if a product with the same code already exists, the screen warns "A product with this code already exists." and does not save. "Name" is how the product appears in the list and to the AI agent. Write it the way a customer would ask for it. Both are required, and the name needs at least 2 letters.
\"Marca\" e \"Categoria\" são opcionais: "Brand" and "Category" are optional and help find the product in search. In "Sale price", write the amount the way you usually do, such as 39,90 or 1.299,90. This field is required: without a readable price, the screen warns "Invalid price. Write it like this: 5.499,00" and does not save. "Cost" is how much the product costs the clinic. It is optional and is not shown to the customer.
A caixa \"Controlar estoque deste produt: The "Track stock for this product" box comes checked. Leave it checked for shelf items and enter in "Quantity" how many units the clinic has; here it is 15. Uncheck it for services and made-to-order items, such as a consultation or a custom insole. When unchecked, the "Quantity" field disappears and the product always counts as available to the AI agent.
Confira tudo e clique em \"Salvar produt: Check everything and click "Save product". Notice that the button that said "New product" now says "Cancel": it closes the form without saving.
O produto entrou na lista: The product is in the list
O formulário fecha e a faixa elástica ap: The form closes and the elastic band appears in the list, in alphabetical order, with its code, brand, the 15 units in stock and the price. From now on, the AI agent can find it when a customer asks.
Corrigir um produto e tirá-lo de venda: Correct a product and take it off sale
Mudar o preço, o estoque ou a descrição: Change a product's price, stock or description and disable what the clinic stopped selling.
Chegou um lote novo de escovas ortodônti: A new batch of orthodontic toothbrushes arrived, and the supplier raised the price. To update the product, click "Edit" on its row.
O formulário abre embaixo da linha, já p: The form opens below the row, already filled in with what is registered. Change what is different: here, the price went to 27,90 and the quantity to 50. Editing has a field that adding does not: "Description". Write in it what customers usually ask. The AI agent receives the description along with the price when it looks up the product.
O que o cliente quer saber: What the customer wants to know
Clique em \"Salvar alterações\". Se você: Click "Save changes". If you did not change anything, the screen warns "Nothing to change." and does not save. "Cancel" closes the form without saving.
O formulário fecha e a linha já mostra o: The form closes and the row now shows the new price and the 50 units in stock. The next time a customer asks, the AI agent replies with the new price.
Desativar o que saiu de venda: Disable what is no longer sold
O fornecedor parou de fabricar o ômega 3: The supplier stopped making the omega 3 the clinic sold. The screen has no button to delete a product: click "Disable". The product stays stored but is taken off sale, because the AI agent only searches active products.
Riscado, no fim da lista: Crossed out, at the end of the list
O nome fica riscado e o produto vai para: The name is crossed out and the product moves to the end of the list, with the other disabled products. The row's button now says "Reactivate": that is how the product goes back on sale.
Pôr fotos num produto e trazer o catálog: Add photos to a product and import the whole catalog from a spreadsheet.
O número entre parênteses no botão \"Fot: The number in parentheses on the "Photos" button shows how many photos the product has. Click "Photos (2)" on the whey row to see its photos.
A primeira foto é a capa: The first photo is the cover
As fotos abrem embaixo da linha. A prime: The photos open below the row. The first one is the cover: it is the one that appears small in the list. When the AI agent presents a product with photos, it can send the photos along, and they go in this order. The arrows move a photo and the "✕" removes it.
\"Adicionar foto\" abre o seu computador: "Add photo" opens your computer so you can choose the image. JPG or PNG photos up to 5 MB are accepted. Each product holds up to 5 photos; with 5, the button is grayed out.
Se a clínica já tem os produtos numa pla: If the clinic already has its products in a spreadsheet, there is no need to add them one by one. Click "Download spreadsheet template" to see the columns the screen understands: código, nome, marca, categoria, preço, custo and estoque. Only the nome and preço columns are required. The screen also recognizes similar names, such as "SKU", "valor" or "qtd". It only accepts .csv files: in Excel, use "Save as" and choose "CSV UTF-8". Then click "Import spreadsheet" and choose the file.
O código liga cada linha da planilha a u: The code links each spreadsheet row to a product. Importing an existing code again, written exactly the same way, updates that product without creating another one: this is how you correct the whole price list at once. If the spreadsheet has no code column, the name plays that role. Importing does not touch the description or the photos, and does not reactivate a disabled product. The description is written on the screen, under "Edit".
Cuidado com o estoque: sem coluna de est: Be careful with stock: without a stock column, every product in the spreadsheet becomes "no stock control", even those that already existed with counted units. At the end, the screen shows a summary with how many are "new", how many were "updated" and the "Rows not imported:", each with its reason.

Encontrar a tela de Propostas e entender: Find the Proposals screen and understand the list: what each column shows and what each status means.
Propostas mora em Ver tudo em CRM: Proposals is in View everything in CRM
No menu lateral, no grupo \"CRM\", cliqu: In the side menu, in the "CRM" group, click "View everything in CRM". The "Proposals" card is in the "Close the sale" section.
